name: supabase
description: Supabase integration for PostgreSQL database, authentication, storage, and edge functions

steps: 1. Go to your Supabase project dashboard
4. Copy the service_role key (under 'Project API keys')

example_prompts: List all tables and their row counts
Show me the RLS policies for the profiles table
Find users who signed up in the last 7 days
What files are in the avatars bucket?
Check edge function logs for errors

rls_examples.select_own: CREATE POLICY 'Users can view own data' ON profiles FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
rls_examples.insert_own: CREATE POLICY 'Users can insert own data' ON profiles FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
rls_examples.admin_all: CREATE POLICY 'Admins can do everything' ON profiles FOR ALL USING (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'admin');

common_queries.auth_users: SELECT id, email, created_at, last_sign_in_at FROM auth.users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;
common_queries.table_sizes: SELECT table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(quote_ident(table_name))) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public';
common_queries.active_connections: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database();

security_notes: Never expose service_role key in client code
Use anon key for client-side operations
Always enable RLS on tables with user data
Test RLS policies with different user contexts
